result.title: Accounting Policy Manual - posting authority, support, approvals
result.text:
HALVARD SYSTEMS - ACCOUNTING POLICY MANUAL (excerpt), effective 2026-01-01
Applies to Halvard Systems Inc. (US), Halvard Systems Ltd (UK), Halvard Systems GmbH (DE).

1. Posting authority. Senior accountants may post manual journal entries up to USD 10,000
   per entry (local-currency entries are measured at the month-end rate of the entry month).
   Any entry above USD 10,000 must be routed to the Controller with an approval request
   (request_approval) immediately after posting; it remains pending until approved.
   Splitting one transaction into several entries to stay under the threshold is prohibited.
2. Support. Every journal entry must have its supporting document(s) attached. An entry
   without support is not a valid entry.
3. Capitalization. Individual equipment purchases of USD 2,500 or more (local-currency
   equivalent at the month-end rate) are capitalized to 1500 Computer Equipment and
   depreciated over 36 months beginning the month after acquisition.
4. Prepaids. Payments covering services or events in future periods (more than one month
   out, or spanning more than one month) above USD 1,000 are recorded as prepaid (1210
   Prepaid Software for software, 1220 Prepaid Insurance for insurance, 1200 Prepaid Expenses
   for everything else, including deposits for future events) and expensed straight-line over
   the coverage period starting the month coverage begins, or when the event occurs.
5. Accruals. Expenses are recorded in the period the goods or services are received. Services
   received but not yet invoiced at month-end are accrued to 2100 Accrued Expenses using the
   best available evidence (vendor statements, approved timesheets, engagement terms).
   Quotes or proposals for future work are not liabilities.
6. Revenue. Revenue is recognized under ASC 606 per the contract terms. Deferred revenue
   (2200) is released as performance obligations are satisfied. Usage earned but not yet
   invoiced is recorded to 1300 Unbilled Receivables.
7. Customer credits. SLA credits are issued only per contract terms and verified uptime data
   (see the monthly uptime report). Credits are recorded as a reduction of the related revenue.
8. Cash application. Customer receipts are applied to invoices per remittance advice. Receipts
   that cannot be matched to an open invoice remain in 2950 Unapplied Cash.
9. FX. Monetary balances denominated in a currency other than the entity's functional
   currency are remeasured at the month-end rate; gains/losses go to 6950 FX Gain/Loss.
   Intercompany charges are recorded by the receiving entity at the month-end rate of the
   month charged.
10. Payroll. Returned payroll deposits are recorded to 2150 Accrued Payroll & Unclaimed
   Wages until reissued. Unpaid wages at month-end are accrued to 2150.
11. Exceptions. Items that cannot be supported must be reported via flag_exception. Never
   post an entry to force a reconciliation or to make balances agree.
12. Periods. January and February 2026 are closed. March 2026 is open.

args.text:
MARCH 2026 REVENUE RECOGNITION - DUNMORE FOODS & HARLOW FREIGHT
Prepared by: Senior Accountant
Date: 2026-04-03

EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
Posted total March 2026 revenue of $10,000 USD across two customers:
- Dunmore Foods: $5,000 (subscription + analytics)
- Harlow Freight: $5,000 (usage-based)

Both entries comply with ASC 606 revenue recognition standards and company policy.

═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

1. DUNMORE FOODS - $5,000 (JE-00311)

BACKGROUND
Dunmore Foods has a subscription arrangement with two distinct performance obligations:

A. CORE PLATFORM SUBSCRIPTION
   Contract: 2026-01-01 to 2026-12-31, $48,000 annually (DOC-0002)
   Invoice: INV-1001, issued 2026-01-01 for $48,000 (DOC-0005)
   
B. ANALYTICS MODULE (Added via Amendment No. 1, DOC-0155)
   Effective: 2026-03-01
   Period: 2026-03-01 to 2026-12-31 (10 months)
   Price: $1,000/month = $10,000 total
   Invoice: INV-1052, issued 2026-03-01 (DOC-0156)
   Distinct: "priced at its standalone selling price" (DOC-0155)

ASC 606 ANALYSIS
Under ASC 606, revenue is recognized when (or as) a performance obligation is satisfied by transferring a promised service to a customer.

Core Subscription Performance Obligation:
- Nature: Platform access (recurring monthly service)
- Satisfaction: Over time, as the service is provided
- Measurement: Ratably over the 12-month contract term
- Monthly amount: $48,000 ÷ 12 = $4,000

Analytics Module Performance Obligation (Distinct):
- Nature: Analytics feature access (distinct from platform, separately priced)
- Satisfaction: Over time, as the service is provided
- Measurement: Ratably over the 10-month contract term (Mar-Dec)
- Monthly amount: $10,000 ÷ 10 = $1,000

MARCH REVENUE RECOGNITION
Core subscription (3rd month):                    $4,000
Analytics module (1st month):                     $1,000
────────────────────────────────────────────────
Total March revenue:                              $5,000

JOURNAL ENTRY POSTED
Debit:  2200 Deferred Revenue                     $5,000
Credit: 4000 Subscription Revenue                           $5,000

Rationale: Monthly release from deferred revenue reflects the satisfaction of each customer's performance obligations in March as platform and analytics access were provided.

Supporting Documents Attached:
- DOC-0002: Original subscription agreement
- DOC-0155: Amendment No. 1 (Analytics module, contract change)
- DOC-0005: Invoice INV-1001
- DOC-0156: Invoice INV-1052

═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

2. HARLOW FREIGHT - $5,000 (JE-00312)

BACKGROUND
Harlow Freight operates under a usage-based agreement:
- Contract: Usage Agreement, dated 2025-12-01 (DOC-0001)
- Price: $0.10 per shipment processed
- Billing: Quarterly in arrears (Q1 invoice issued in April)

CONTRACT TERMS (ASC 606 ANALYSIS)
Performance Obligation: Satisfy shipment processing requests
Satisfaction Trigger: "Halvard's performance obligation is satisfied as each shipment is processed" (DOC-0001)
Measurement: Usage earned in real time as transactions occur

March 2026 Activity:
Shipments processed: 50,000 (DOC-0206)
Revenue earned: 50,000 × $0.10 = $5,000

TIMING UNDER ASC 606
- Performance obligation: Satisfied in March as shipments were processed
- Revenue recognition: Required in March (performance obligation met)
- Invoicing: Not until early April (Q1 summary invoice)
- Accounting treatment: Creates a contract asset (unbilled receivable)

Per company policy section 6: "Usage earned but not yet invoiced is recorded to 1300 Unbilled Receivables (Contract Asset)."

JOURNAL ENTRY POSTED
Debit:  1300 Unbilled Receivables (Contract Asset)  $5,000
Credit: 4100 Usage Revenue                                   $5,000

Rationale: As shipments were processed in March, Harlow Freight satisfied its contractual performance obligation. Per ASC 606, revenue must be recognized in the period earned, even though formal invoicing occurs in the following period. The unbilled receivable will be satisfied when the Q1 invoice is issued and cash is received in April.

Supporting Documents Attached:
- DOC-0001: Harlow Freight Usage Agreement (contract terms)
- DOC-0206: Harlow Freight usage report for March 2026 (50,000 shipments)

═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

POLICY COMPLIANCE
✓ Both entries under $10,000 USD threshold (no controller approval required)
✓ Both entries fully supported with contracts and reports
✓ Both comply with ASC 606 revenue recognition principles
✓ Usage revenue correctly treated as contract asset pending Q1 invoice
✓ Subscription revenue correctly released from deferred revenue
✓ Distinct performance obligations properly identified (Dunmore Analytics)

MARCH CLOSE IMPACT
Total subscription and usage revenue recognized in March: $10,000
- Dunmore Foods: $5,000 (2200 Deferred Revenue reduced; 4000 Revenue increased)
- Harlow Freight: $5,000 (1300 Contract Asset created; 4100 Revenue recognized)

Both entries are complete, supported, and ready for month-end close.
